key_stat: UK's largest share registrar | Paymaster services | EQ Boardroom
summary: Equiniti (now EQ) is the UK's largest share registrar, managing shareholder records for ~50% of FTSE 100 companies. Also provides payment services, pension administration, remediation services, and employee share plans. Acquired by Siris Capital (PE) in 2023. US operations via EQ Shareowner Services. Key platforms: EQ Boardroom (corporate governance), share registration, dividend processing, employee benefits administration.

business_segments.name: Registration Services
business_segments.detail: Share registration for ~50% FTSE 100. Dividend processing. Corporate actions.

business_segments.name: Remediation Services
business_segments.detail: Complex remediation for banks and insurers. PPI, interest rate hedging.

business_segments.name: Employee Benefits
business_segments.detail: Share plans, employee benefits administration. SaaS platforms.

technology.ai: Exploring AI for remediation, customer service.
technology.cloud: Cloud migration for platforms. Legacy modernisation.
technology.data: Massive shareholder data. Payment data. Benefits data.
technology.platforms: EQ Boardroom, share registration systems, payment platforms, benefits platforms.
technology.spend: Moderate. PE owner will focus on efficiency + growth.

operating_model: PE-owned (Siris Capital). Efficiency focus. Platform consolidation. UK + US operations.
coforge_angle: NN TAL. EQ has significant legacy platforms needing modernisation. PE ownership drives efficiency + digital transformation. Coforge can support platform engineering, cloud migration, and automation.
